name: merageo-ai-visibility
description: Check how often AI assistants mention a website, using meraGEO reports.

interface.shortDescription: Check AI visibility of a site
interface.longDescription: meraGEO shows how often AI assistants mention a website when people ask category questions. Look up the latest stored report for a domain: an overall 0-100 visibility score, how many of the sampled answers mention the site, and the main issues found, such as a missing llms.txt file, schema markup, meta description or sitemap. You can also request a new scan for a domain. A scan reads the site's public pages and asks several AI models category questions, and it takes a few minutes. Signing in to meraGEO is required to use the tools. The plugin works one domain at a time and reports only what meraGEO returns. It does not explain why a score is what it is beyond the issues listed. meraGEO is a product of Okyasoft Pte Ltd, Singapore.
defaultPrompt: How visible is example.com in AI assistant answers?
Has meraGEO scanned my site yet?
Is the scan for example.com finished?

positive.prompt: How visible is example.com in AI assistant answers?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the stored report for example.com: a 0-100 visibility score with its label, how many of the sampled ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini answers mention the site, the top issues and the scan date. No invented numbers.

positive.prompt: Has anyone checked brand-new-startup-demo.io with meraGEO?
positive.expected_behavior: Says no report exists yet for the domain and offers to start a scan, without starting one.

positive.prompt: Yes, run a meraGEO scan for brand-new-startup-demo.io.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a scan and says it takes a few minutes, with status scanning. If a recent report already exists, it says so and points to it instead.

positive.prompt: Is the meraGEO scan for brand-new-startup-demo.io finished?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether the scan is still running, complete with its score, or failed with an offer to retry.
Reduces the URL to example.com and returns that domain's stored report.

negative.prompt: Write a 500 word blog post about SEO tips.
Run a meraGEO scan on localhost:3000 and on 192.168.1.10.
